issues.display_title: Issue #519: Add Status Follower in API Search User
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Search User — Followed Status

Issue: #519 (follow-up to #451)

Route

GET /search/user?search=&page=&limit=
Authorization: <JWT token>

Unchanged route and query params; only the response gains a field.

Changes

  • Models/SearchModel.go: added a Followed bool field to SearchUser, tagged json:"followed" and gorm:"-". It is gorm:"-" because the value comes from a separate followers lookup, not from the followers_counts select.
  • Action/V1/Search/SearchUser.go: captured the caller's user id into a new myUserId variable inside the existing role == "user" block (from the UserFunctions.UserDatas call already made there), and set Followed for each result inside the loop that already fetches each user's 4 recent posts.
  • Did not change the query, pagination, ordering, filters, or any existing response field.

Data Flow

  1. Role and encrypt come from the auth middleware locals; the handler already rejects anything other than "user" or "viewer" with 401.
  2. For role == "user", UserFunctions.UserDatas(c, encrypt) is already called to validate the account and read last_login; the same map now also supplies user_id, stored in myUserId. Viewers never enter that block, so myUserId stays empty for them.
  3. The search query against followers_counts runs unchanged.
  4. In the per-result loop, after the recent-posts query, Followed is resolved with UserFunctions.CheckFollowed(myUserId, rowSearchUser[i].ID) — the same helper Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollower.go and ProfileFollowing.go use, so the meaning of "followed" stays identical across endpoints.
  5. The lookup is skipped entirely when myUserId is empty, so viewers get followed: false without any extra query.

Behaviour

  • Authenticated user: true when a followers row exists with user_id = the result's id and follower_id = the caller.
  • Viewer (unauthenticated): always false.
  • The caller's own account, when it appears in its own search results: false, since no self-follow row exists.

Files

  • src/Models/SearchModel.go
  • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchUser.go
  • src/Action/V1/Search/SearchUser_test.go (new)

Verification

gofmt -l src/Action/V1/Search/SearchUser.go src/Models/SearchModel.go
go build ./...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Search/ ./src/Models/
go test ./src/Action/V1/Search/

Results: build, vet, and gofmt clean on the touched files; package tests pass, including the new
TestSearchUserResponseExposesFollowedAndHidesIdentifiers, which asserts the marshalled payload
contains "followed" and still omits id and encrypt.

Note: gofmt -l src/Action/V1/Search/ reports seven other files in the package as unformatted. They
were already unformatted before this change and were left untouched.

Not yet done: manual smoke test against a running server with a real follow relationship.

Known gaps

  • One followers query per result row (at most limit, default 8) on top of the recent-posts query
    the loop already ran. This matches the existing N+1 shape of this handler and of
    ProfileFollower.go. If the search limit is ever raised well above 8, replace it with a single
    WHERE user_id IN (?) AND follower_id = ? lookup and a map.
